name: m12-m13-modes-smoke
description: Can M12 and M13 build and apply each explicit mode profile on the three frozen smoke seeds? This is an 18-cell build/configuration and reachability probe, not a survival comparison. The lunal flag permits the mode; it does not prove mode entry. A run with no entry or no execution of the changed branch is not exercised, never a neutral result for Lunal fixes. The unrestricted/source-gated variants required by issue #87 are not supplied by these profiles. Prepared only; no dispatch authorized by this definition.
